mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased economic activity, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 1% MoM does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals weakening labor market conditions, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS < 0% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals tightening monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS < -1% MoM does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 0.5% MoM and PAYEMS < 0% do not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
